steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Paper 2 is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: It focuses on Homer's Odyssey — you need detailed knowledge of the set books | Key Fact: The paper tests literary analysis: character, theme, plot and Homer's techniques | Key Fact: Character questions ask you to analyse Odysseus, Penelope, Telemachus and the suitors
